about_the_game:
Eldorion: Guardians of The Crystals

A pixel art exploration game where you must face various challenges and collect crystals to save Earth from its impending doom. An RPG with multiple continents that have emerged, bringing forth a new era of mysticism.

Story

A global cataclysm reshaped Earth. New continents emerged, bringing forth a new era of mysticism.

Elena's peaceful life is disrupted when her father, a renowned archaeologist, discovers one of the Crystals of Hope. Upon touching this Crystal, Elena experiences memories of her past lives, revealing her true mission—to gather all six Crystals of Hope to prevent an unprecedented catastrophe.

The planet Eldorion, on a collision course with Earth, threatens all life. On this journey, Elena is accompanied by her father and her friends, known as the Guardians of the Crystals. Together, they will do everything in their power to help Elena fulfill her mission and, through the power of the Crystals of Hope, alter Eldorion’s trajectory, saving all life on Earth. However, the "Cult of the End of Times," a sect that has lost faith in humanity, will stop at nothing to prevent Elena from completing her journey.
